title: SpaceX to buy Cursor AI coding agent operator Anysphere for $60B
summary: SpaceX announces acquisition of Anysphere, the company behind popular AI coding assistant Cursor, for $60 billion in what would be one of the largest AI company acquisitions, potentially bringing advanced AI-powered development tools to SpaceX's engineering operations.
problem_solved: Addresses the need for accelerated software development through AI-assisted coding integrated into enterprise engineering environments.
why_valuable: The $60B valuation signals the enormous market value of AI coding tools and represents a strategic move to embed AI development capabilities directly into SpaceX's technology stack.
